content.short: Galxe provides credential and identity infrastructure for verifying users, building campaigns, and managing Web3 reputation.
content.description: Galxe builds credential and identity infrastructure for Web3 communities, applications, and growth programs. Its current docs emphasize self-sovereign identity, zero-knowledge proof based credential verification, and APIs that let builders check eligibility, reputation, or user achievements without exposing unnecessary data. Beyond identity rails, Galxe is widely used for quests, community campaigns, and access control tied to onchain or offchain behavior. On Mantle, it fits as a credential and engagement layer for teams that want to verify users, run campaigns, and build reputation-aware product flows.
